samuel2.22.p1.b1.text: … on the day the LORD had delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul.

samuel2.22.p1.b2.text: And David sang this song to the LORD …

samuel2.22.p2.b1.text: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer.

samuel2.22.p2.b2.text: My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge,

samuel2.22.p2.b3.text: my shield, and the horn of my salvation. My stronghold, my refuge

samuel2.22.p2.b4.text: I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; so shall I be saved from my enemies.

samuel2.22.p3.b1.text: For the waves of death engulfed me; the torrents of chaos overwhelmed me.

samuel2.22.p3.b2.text: The cords of Sheol entangled me; the snares of death confronted me.

samuel2.22.p3.b3.text: In my distress I called upon the LORD; I cried out to my God.

samuel2.22.p3.b4.text: And from His temple He heard my voice, and my cry for help reached His ears.

samuel2.22.p4.b1.text: Then the earth shook and quaked; the foundations of the heavens trembled; they were shaken because He burned with anger.

samuel2.22.p4.b2.text: Smoke rose from His nostrils, and consuming fire came from His mouth; glowing coals blazed forth.

samuel2.22.p4.b3.text: He parted the heavens and came down with dark clouds beneath His feet.

samuel2.22.p4.b4.text: He mounted a cherub and flew; He soared on the wings of the wind.

samuel2.22.p5.b1.text: He shot His arrows and scattered the foes; He hurled lightning and routed them.

samuel2.22.p5.b2.text: The channels of the sea appeared, and the foundations of the world were exposed at the rebuke of the LORD, at the blast of the breath of His nostrils.

samuel2.22.p5.b3.text: He reached down from on high and took hold of me; He drew me out of deep waters.

samuel2.22.p5.b4.text: He brought me out into the open; He rescued me because He delighted in me.

samuel2.22.p6.b1.text: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness; He has repaid me according to the cleanness of my hands.

samuel2.22.p6.b2.text: To the faithful You show Yourself faithful, to the blameless You show Yourself blameless;

samuel2.22.p6.b3.text: You save an afflicted people, but Your eyes are on the haughty to bring them down.

samuel2.22.p7.b1.text: For You, O LORD, are my lamp; the LORD lights up my darkness.

samuel2.22.p7.b2.text: For in You I can charge an army; with my God I can scale a wall.

samuel2.22.p7.b3.text: He makes my feet like those of a deer and stations me upon the heights.

samuel2.22.p7.b4.text: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.

samuel2.22.p8.b1.text: I pursued my enemies and destroyed them; I did not turn back until they were consumed.

samuel2.22.p8.b2.text: You have made my enemies retreat before me; I put an end to those who hated me.

samuel2.22.p8.b3.text: Foreigners cower before me; when they hear me, they obey me.

samuel2.22.p8.b4.text: Foreigners lose heart and come trembling from their strongholds.

samuel2.22.p9.b1.text: The LORD lives, and blessed be my Rock! And may God, the Rock of my salvation, be exalted

samuel2.22.p9.b2.text: Therefore I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing praises to Your name.

samuel2.22.p9.b3.text: Great salvation He brings to His king. He shows loving devotion to His anointed, to David and his descendants forever.
